articles.title: AMD acquires ‘godmother of AI’ Li Fei-Fei’s start-up as battle with Nvidia intensifies
articles.summary: AMD's acquisition of World Labs, founded by AI pioneer Li Fei-Fei for $8.2 billion, marks a significant strategic move to enhance its AI capabilities and intensify competition with Nvidia, potentially reshaping the landscape of artificial intelligence technology. This integration of cutting-edge research and spatial-intelligence expertise could propel AMD to the forefront of AI innovation.

articles.title: China reveals plan to map the entire surface of Mars by 2028 amid race with US
articles.summary: China's ambitious plan to create the first AI-driven geological map of Mars by 2028 not only positions it as a leader in extraterrestrial exploration but also intensifies the ongoing space rivalry with the United States, setting a new global standard for understanding the Martian landscape and its geological history.

articles.title: In the US-China AI race, the real fight is keeping humans in control
articles.summary: The escalating US-China AI competition highlights a critical dilemma: as both nations race to harness the economic and strategic advantages of increasingly autonomous AI, the urgent need for human oversight becomes paramount, underscoring the potential risks of unchecked technological advancement. This tension was starkly illustrated during last week’s summit, where contrasting approaches to AI regulation were openly debated.

articles.title: How we will do better for Australia
articles.summary: OpenAI has acknowledged past issues with Australian government websites and is committing to enhanced safeguards and support, marking a significant step towards bolstering Australia's cybersecurity infrastructure and restoring trust in AI technologies. This breakthrough is crucial as it not only addresses previous vulnerabilities but also sets a precedent for responsible AI deployment in government operations.

articles.title: Watch the winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE, The Gifted.
articles.summary: The winning trailer from the Future Vision XPRIZE, titled The Gifted, showcases groundbreaking advancements in AI-driven storytelling, highlighting its potential to revolutionize how narratives are crafted and experienced in the digital age. This breakthrough not only sets a new standard for creative expression but also emphasizes the transformative power of technology in shaping our future.

articles.title: China targets AI and frontier tech in newly unveiled innovation blueprint
articles.summary: China's newly unveiled five-year innovation blueprint prioritizes artificial intelligence and frontier technologies, positioning the nation to intensify its global competitive edge in science and technology as it aims for leadership in these critical fields by 2030. This strategic focus underscores the urgency for nations to innovate rapidly in response to escalating technological rivalries.

articles.title: Chinese commercial reactor achieves nuclear fusion with clean hydrogen-boron fuel
articles.summary: A Chinese company has made a groundbreaking achievement in nuclear fusion by successfully controlling hydrogen-boron plasma, a significant step towards neutron-free magnetic confinement fusion that promises a cleaner and more sustainable energy future. This milestone with the EXL-50U reactor could revolutionize energy production by eliminating harmful neutron emissions associated with traditional fusion methods.

articles.title: Chinese chip foundry CanSemi’s IPO oversubscribed 2,360 times as investors chase AI boom
articles.summary: CanSemi Technology's IPO has been oversubscribed by an astonishing 2,360 times, highlighting the immense investor confidence in its advancements in silicon photonics and its pivotal role in bolstering China's artificial intelligence infrastructure, signaling a significant shift in the tech landscape. This unprecedented demand underscores the growing urgency to capitalize on the AI boom and the strategic importance of domestic semiconductor capabilities.

articles.title: Affect theory
articles.summary:
• Affect theory challenges the dominance of language in shaping human experience, emphasizing the primacy of emotions and bodily sensations.  
• This shift invites a deeper exploration of how feelings influence our perceptions, relationships, and social interactions.  
• By prioritizing affect, theorists reveal the complexities of human existence that transcend mere linguistic constructs.  
• The body becomes a site of knowledge, suggesting that understanding ourselves requires engaging with our visceral experiences.  
• Ultimately, affect theory reshapes our understanding of identity, community, and the ways we connect with the world around us.

articles.title: Paternity is poetical
articles.summary:
• Fatherhood can be a profound source of inspiration, intertwining creativity with the emotional depths of parenting.  
• The traditional view that fatherhood stifles artistic expression is challenged by the rich, transformative experiences it offers.  
• Neuroscience reveals that the brain's capacity for creativity can be enhanced through the complexities of paternal bonds.  
• Engaging with the responsibilities of fatherhood can lead to a deeper understanding of the human condition, fueling poetic expression.  
• The intersection of fatherhood and creativity invites a reevaluation of how we perceive artistic identity and familial roles.

articles.title: ByteDance grabs one-fifth of China’s data centre capacity as AI drives infrastructure boom
articles.summary: ByteDance has emerged as a dominant force in China's data center landscape, securing one-fifth of the nation's capacity and positioning itself as the largest tenant, a move that underscores its critical role in fueling the rapid expansion of artificial intelligence infrastructure. This breakthrough not only highlights ByteDance's strategic investment in AI but also signals a significant shift in the tech ecosystem, as the demand for data processing power surges.

articles.title: The Lenfest Institute grows landmark program with expanded OpenAI support
articles.summary: OpenAI is significantly enhancing the Lenfest AI Collaborative and Fellowship Program with a groundbreaking $5 million investment and an additional $5 million in software credits and engineering support, marking a pivotal step in advancing AI research and innovation in journalism. This expansion not only underscores OpenAI's commitment to fostering responsible AI development but also empowers media organizations to leverage cutting-edge technology for enhanced storytelling and audience engagement.
